name: Texas-mountain-laurel
desc: Texas-mountain-laurel (Dermatophyllum secundiflorum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 10 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Dermatophyllum secundiflorum is a species of flowering shrub or small tree in the family Fabaceae that is native to the Southwestern United States (Texas, New Mexico) and Mexico.
